description: Portrait of O'Keeffe posing for Ansel Adams; Adams is in the foreground (slightly out of focus) looking down into the viewfinder of a Hasselblad on a tripod with glasses on his forehead; in the bottom right of the photograph is quarter- length view of O'Keeffe (in focus) with her hair pulled back from her face wearing a black suit coat and a white shirt with her Alexander Calder silver pin at the neck; a lamp-shade and flowering plants are visible behind her head.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe and Ansel Adams, Carmel, California
